essence:
The Buddhist's pūrvapakṣa (V1-F..J) has denied the self, the cognition, the action,
and the relation.

Bowing to the will-power-full, nectar-shining, capable of generating endless worlds; the Bhairava-joy,
thickened by the waves of the own-power… The siddhānta is established in two adhikāras.
